R1.description: the repository's own installed release is admitted through the Controller's capability rule (every non-Manager step of inspect) with no vendored tree and no version literal, and a non-protocol release, a protocol-major-2 release or an unsupported profile is refused by the same admission

R2.description: the installed Workflow files are checked against the digests and modes in installation.json, and a modified, missing or extra file fails by name

R3.description: no test requires a vendored tree for the installed release; the vendored-tree tests are unchanged and pass

R4.description: the guide, compatibility and roadmap pages agree, and check_docs and the full suite are green
